core_obligations: Choose a free resolution of the base ring over the ground ring (proof lines 14960-14963).
Use Tor independence to show that tensoring the resolution with the algebra gives a free resolution of the base changed algebra (proof lines 14963-14966).
Compare the two total complexes by the general construction and conclude that the comparison map is an isomorphism (proof lines 14966-14973).
proof_roadmap: Resolve the base ring by free modules (proof lines 14960-14963).
Show the tensored resolution is a resolution by Tor independence (proof lines 14963-14966).
Identify the two total complexes and conclude (proof lines 14966-14974).
difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the condition under which the comparison map between two ways of forming a base changed complex is an isomorphism, and the proof is a 15-line argument built on the choice of a free resolution. It resolves the base ring over the ground ring by free modules, uses the Tor independence hypothesis to see that tensoring the resolution with the algebra still gives a free resolution, and then compares the four total complexes appearing in the chain by the general construction of the derived tensor product. Each isomorphism in the displayed chain is justified by a named construction, and the chain is written out in full.
